description: This file defines a static class DbConstantsStore that manages database constants and capabilities for different ADO.NET providers, including support for command cancellation, streaming, and escape characters. It also contains a class DbConstants that encapsulates these properties.

classes.name: DbConstantsStore
classes.description: A static class providing access to database-specific constants and capabilities based on the ADO.NET provider invariant name.

classes.name: DbConstants
classes.description: A class encapsulating database-specific constants such as escape characters, query templates, and support flags.

methods.name: GetDbConstants
methods.description: Retrieves the DbConstants object for a given invariant name.

methods.name: SupportsCommandCancellation
methods.description: Checks if the storage or provider supports command cancellation.

methods.name: SupportsStreamNatively
methods.description: Checks if the storage or provider supports native streaming.

methods.name: IsSynchronousAdoNetImplementation
methods.description: Determines if the ADO.NET implementation is synchronous for a given provider.

methods.name: GetDatabaseCommandInterceptor
methods.description: Retrieves the command interceptor associated with a specific provider.
